opis:
The Lean and Mathlib community officially confirmed that Stanford's Levent Alpöge proved the Riemann Hypothesis. Separately, the Wall Street Journal reports, citing unnamed sources, that the Trump administration plans to name more than twenty AI "national champions," including Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic. There is no official confirmation yet.

naslov: Perplexity Monitor API: watch the web and get a webhook when it matters | AI Tool #28
opis:
An API that searches the web on a schedule, or watches up to 10 pages, and sends a webhook only when it finds something relevant to the goal you described in words.

How to try it:
1. Go to the Perplexity API console and create an API key (the same key works for the Search, Context and Agent APIs).
2. Send a POST request to api.perplexity.ai/v1/monitors with a query, goal, schedule and webhook URL.
3. For the webhook, you can build a Supabase Edge Function or try it with webhook.site.
4. For the exact request fields, check the documentation at the link.

Price: $1 per 1,000 successful runs (web), $1 per 1,000 fetched URLs (pages)

Official link: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/introducing-perplexitys-monitor-api

naslov: Unsloth Desktop: run local AI models free, no terminal needed | AI Tool #29
opis:
A free app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs GGUF and MLX models (Qwen3.8-27B, Inkling 2 Mini, gpt-oss-20b) on your own computer and can share them across your home network.

How to try it:
1. Download Unsloth Desktop from unsloth.ai/docs/desktop.
2. In the model picker at the top left, choose a model and a quantization (a compressed version of the model) that fits your memory. On a Mac, take the MLX version.
3. Click the gear next to the model and set the context length (or leave it on Auto), then start chatting.
4. If you want others on your network to use it: Settings → Remote & LAN, set a password and click Start.

Price: free

Official link: https://www.gpupartner.com/blog/beginners-guide-local-ai-inkling-qwen-unsloth

naslov: What is a webhook? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A webhook is an automatic message one app sends to another the moment something happens, so nobody has to keep checking. Example: Perplexity's new Monitor API searches the web on a schedule, as often as every 15 minutes, and sends a webhook only when it finds something relevant to your goal.
